Name: Jai_MoreDisciples
DisplayName: More Disciples | 提高弟子数量
Desc:
Allows higher disciple count limit, defaulting to 24 disciples (increased from 18) after reaching [Paradise] sect size. This limit can optionally be configured through the [Hotkey Adapter] mod.
 1. Default
 2. Match Desktop: The limits are adjusted to match the limits on desktop version of the game
 3. Max: The limits are adjusted to the maximum, reaching 72 after reaching [Paradise] sect size (not recommended to use this setting)

用于提高弟子数量上限，默认在门派达到【洞天】后提升到24名弟子。这上限能有选择性地通过【快捷键连接器】 MOD 被设定。
 1. 默认
 2. 和电脑版持平
 3. 最大增幅：上限调整至极限，在门派达到【洞天】后提升到72名弟子
Author: Jai
